response_notes: C100 examples explicitly use either 200 or 800 per operation; N100 schemas explicitly require 800. CFW_0000 is a documented success code, not an error merely because the field is named error.
N100 price schemas say isSuccess but all populated examples use isSucceed; preserve the captured wire field and enforce its Boolean success.
N100 order responses check the top-level submitted flag; per-order outcomes remain visible in the captured result and must be inspected for partial failures.

The malformed subnet example clearly contains a sequence of subnet objects and a closing array bracket although its schema says Object. Preserve the captured array shape with a repaired opening bracket.

Table columns use captured wire spellings where schema case or spelling variants would duplicate a key: vpcID/vpcId, vpcQuotaUsedCount/VpcQuotaUsedCount, firewallEdition/firewallEdtion, canCreateTask/canCreatTask and isSucceed/isSuccess.
